messages:
erin: Quick bring-up for Polaris-14b quant variants. Ran 20k mixed-slice runs (long QA, multi-paragraph summarization, rerank). Posting compact take + recommended routing.
erin: TL;DR: int6 tuned reduces token-unit cost ~18% and improves p50 latency on short generators, but we see a noticeable drop (~4.1pp) on multi-span QA exact-match and a 3.8% MAP drop on reranker tasks.
samir: numbers + sample split?
erin: samples: 20k (9k long-QA, 7k summarization, 4k rerank). Hosted proxy unit: int8 $0.0105/k, int6 $0.0086/k => -18.1%. p50 latency: int8 480ms -> int6 420ms. p95: int8 1100ms -> int6 1128ms. throughput +10% on dedicated fleet.
hajra: how measured QA recall? priming sensitivity?
erin: primary = span exact-match on long-QA L4. Priming sweep shows int6 degrades when prompts include multiple examples or >900 token concat (KV noise). Reranker flips occur mostly on near-tie candidates.
devops-bot: smoke check: polaris-int6-smoke OK (4769123720)
samir: can we rescue with decoding changes or shadow scoring?
erin: decoding tweaks help marginally but increase cost. Proposal: hybrid flow — allow int6 for generator-only/light-summary calls (est_out <250 tokens) and force int8 for doc-qa/rerank/multi-example prompts. Add priming-guard: if examples_count >=2 and examples_tokens >400 -> force int8.
hajra: monitoring plan?
erin: Canary: 10% eligible short-gen traffic for 48h. Track: long-QA exact-match by slice, reranker MAP, ROUGE-L for summaries, unit-cost delta, p95 latency. Alert if long-QA exact drops >2% or reranker MAP drops >1.5%.
product: we'll add feature_hint to SDK (eg {"feature":"summary","est_out":150}). Default conservative. Customers can opt into "cost-mode" per app.
samir: infra note: for Dedicated we can increase batch size for int6 to boost econ wins but must watch KV hit and memory eviction.
erin: action items: (1) eng-platform implement routing + priming-guard (2) observability: canary dashboard + failing-query capture (3) product: SDK flag + opt-in UI (4) eng-ml: provide failing examples CSV for review. I'll open canary ticket.
devops-bot: Canary ticket created: ML-4221 (polaris-int6-hybrid-route) - 4769123800
